sourceNotes.rawContent: Complete your look with our ultra-feminine Bow Jewelry Set. Featuring a matching necklace and drop earrings paired with a dazzling stone-studded tennis bracelet, this curated collection is the ultimate statement for the modern romantic. These fashion-forward pieces are designed for high-impact styling; to keep their golden brilliance and sparkle lasting through every event, we recommend keeping them dry and storing them in a cool, moisture-free space after use.
